_comment: What's new: shown once to each player after an update. Newest first. id must go up by 1 with every new entry. game = page name without .html (farm, race, tycoon ...) or all.

items: Lumberyard, Farm and Smelter piles stop at 99% full; everything past that is shared out to your other buildings' build and upgrade pads, so nothing goes to waste
See your allies walking around live: when you visit them (or they visit you) you can see each other, with a 🤝 name tag
New crews: the Smelter sends miners to break rocks and the Farm sends hunters after deer (1 per level, up to 4), like the Lumberyard's lumberjacks. They fill the building's pile for you to pick up
Playing on your own map shares a little of what you gather with your allies: 5% each with one ally, down to 1% each with five or more
Work on your ally's settlement: build on their pads and gather there. Everything is split 50/50: half for their settlement, half for yours (pads you fill there also fill the same build at home)
Your ally's half arrives in their game automatically
Wood now shows as a real log picture everywhere (no more empty boxes)
Visiting an ally pays: a daily visit bonus for each friend, and anything you gather there comes home with you
Visit really takes you to your friend's settlement: walk around it, help their timers, then 🏠 Go home
Lumberjacks: the Lumberyard sends out workers (1 per level, up to 4) who chop trees and bring the logs to its pile
Tap any building to see what it does now and what its next level adds (and what it costs)
Fixed the little boxes where some icons didn't show on Windows
Allies: your friends list shows up automatically with who needs help — no more typing friend codes
Achievements show every farmer's progress on your multiplayer farm, in their colour
A sign over each of your fields shows the countdown, ✅ READY TO HARVEST, or 💧 needs water
Minimap: growing crops go from dark to light green as they grow, gold when ready
Minimap: each of your fields shows a countdown until it's ready to harvest (💧 if some still need water)
After every update, this card shows what changed
Fields split into strips by the seeds you select again (1 = whole field, 2 = halves, 3 = thirds)
Switch vehicles with Tab, the 🔄 Switch button or Triangle on a controller
Combine tank holds one field (240) and unloads into the trailer by itself when full
The truck and trailer park beside the field you're harvesting
Daily missions grow with your farm, and a New missions button appears once they're all done
Shared multiplayer XP stops at level 20; after that everyone levels on their own
The farmhouse opens: kitchen, missions, achievements and your farm record
Grain elevator moved away from the shop; drive the combine there to unload it directly
Extra-wide implements: 7 tiles at once (level 20)
Level-up card lists everything you unlocked and what's next
Tractor and combine drive back to their parking spots when you get out
Fields show their number in the owner's colour
Achievements show progress bars
Fertilizer is sold at the barn again and shared on multiplayer farms
Fertilized soil turns olive-green so you can see what's covered
Pigs, compost tower and the fertilizer seeder upgrade
Kitchen: Make all button
Tractor and combine engine sounds (🔊 button to mute)
Rain no longer freezes the game
